summary: QTREX Quantum Ltd., a Nasdaq-listed Israeli foreign private issuer (formerly Inspira Technologies), furnished a Form 6-K containing its first-half 2026 results: record revenue of $1.55 million, up roughly 438% year over year, at a 61% gross margin, plus interim financial statements and MD&A. The release references the completed April 6, 2026 acquisition of an AME platform for $2.0 million cash plus contingent consideration, and launches of INSU300 and related commercial agreements. The filing is an ordinary earnings/interim-report update, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are newly disclosed. Watch for the announced fourth-quarter commercial agreements and 2027 outlook.
